checks.simplify: 4 agents. Applied: (1) LOGO constant {src,width,height} in lib/site.ts consumed by header/footer/OG - the reuse agent found REALIZED drift (OG declared 1491x1055 vs actual 1248x667), so the constant fixes a live bug, not hypothetical duplication; (2) header img alt emptied - the wrapping Link's aria-label supersedes descendant alt in accname computation, so the mirrored alt only made screen readers announce the brand twice; footer's standalone Image keeps its alt (structurally different); (3) inert min-h-11 dropped from the Link (children now h-12/16/20 - the 44px floor can never bind); (4) stale Wordmark comment removed. Skipped with reasons: shared lockup React component (reuse agent itself recommends against - 2 rendered call sites with different wrappers, and the OG consumer can't use a component; the constant is strictly more reusable); footer.tagline -> top-level rename (minimal-diff); peritwin-mark.png deletion (efficiency agent's caution wins over the other two agents' delete-now: possible external hotlinks from Brevo emails / the frozen Netlify .ai site must be ruled out first - folded into the deferred task chip). Efficiency numbers: bundle sheds 84KB (nav png gone); scroll-to-footer visitors -84KB (-31%, one logo fetch instead of two); bounce-only visitors +106KB on the critical path (185KB lockup now priority-preloaded) - the regression is quantified and owned by the deferred logo-sm.webp chip (~520px shared variant, ~25-50KB, would beat BOTH pre-diff numbers). Altitude: one-notch height bump judged the minimal faithful read (at old heights the wordmark would render markedly smaller than before - under-delivering the ask; the new art is NARROWER at every breakpoint, easing nav crowding); anchor-scroll path verified by token math - scroll-padding 6rem + scroll-mt-24 are additive = 192px effective offset vs 129px lg header = 63px clearance, no anchor lands under the header.
checks.watch_items: (a) h-20 is the header-height CEILING under current layout constants: md:pt-32 (128px) on home/contact/partners/pilots vs 129px lg header leaves -1px, absorbed by internal section padding today - any future height notch must revisit those four pt-32 values AND globals.css scroll-padding; (b) globals.css scroll-padding-top 6rem no longer clears the lg header ALONE (96 < 129) - the invariant survives only via additive scroll-mt-24 on targets; a future anchor target added WITHOUT scroll-mt-24 lands ~33px under the header (latent trap widened from 17px pre-diff, optional fix: raise to 8.5rem); (c) deferred chip: shared peritwin-logo-sm.webp + peritwin-mark.png orphan (hotlink check vs Brevo/frozen-Netlify first).
